test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair of letter-clusters which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two sets of pair of letter-clusters given below. Both pairs of letter-clusters follow the same pattern.

CGJ : HLO

KPS : PUX
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

Logic :- (5) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

**Given :**

 
• CGJ : HLO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c08c3e6fc146f145cb99db59ad76dad66ca4d8cf27e422bf15b98a7539760591.png] 

And,

 
• KPS : PUX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ab838e7ef83e3368400e59cfa3ae19e913fdfc07203b41554751275578ab2f2.png] 

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : FKL : KPQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55a33125a1a46d389e94099ad3eaca1861305896fcccaad3a203e8847ea7d79f.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : WXY : GEF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42610477b6044f0e9ee9ec103abb4a4f6652005e5b27ce7e23e5a5e6b847ae85.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : DEF : ABC​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa332da3e3522ef7e031dd30155ff421e8a501d2d588cb216fe014dd22f08d53.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : HGK : SQP​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82cdf04997a18b8dc4f91f6b480ae760ea74cf1795a8c9802d809a0a48144aac.png] 

Thus, out of all options only '**FKL : KPQ**' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option - (1)**".

89:T
